g.text: Intrinsic XY. No roof primitives, ridge / valley / hip, heights or solver.
Gray dashed: retained analytic cut. Green dotted: consumed inside compound part.
Teal arrows: member attachment toward receiver (conditional when marked ?), not roof edges.
All candidate thumbnails are minimum partitions.
Retained candidates are not independent roof objects.
Compound parts retain member geometry and local relations.
An ambiguous recommendation has no selected main direction.
Minimum candidate gallery; retained means eligible under published score bounds
All retained ArchitecturalPart graphs; part colors and consumed cuts
